parts.text: {"id":"R0121","decision":"INCLUDE","primary":"","reason":"All eligibility criteria E1-E7 satisfied (keeping prior E5/E1-E4/E6 INCLUDE basis); E7 verified via supplied official ICTEE double-blind peer-review policy and R0121 PDF §§3, 5, 6 substantive SwarmNS-MAC method and analytical evaluation.","e":{"E7":["T",0,"Paper Review Process, item 4","is then sent to two independent reviewers","Browser could not load https://science.lpnu.ua/ictee/paper-review-process directly; citing supplied verified ICTEE policy evidence ("is then sent to two independent reviewers" followed by parenthetical double-blind peer review, heading Paper Review Process, item 4). R0121 PDF check (restart_2026_11_26/fulltext_retrieval/pdf/R0121.pdf): §3 (pp. 3-4) formalizes the dynamic UAV swarm mesh graph G(t)=(V,E(t)), split-DNN cut point k, and aggregator MinQuorum q; §5 (pp. 5-6) derives analytical equations (1)-(7) for quantized tensor size S_a, frame count N_f, traffic volume V, per-hop transmission time T_tx (L2 P=2280 B, H_L2=58 B vs L2-L7 P=1448 B, H_L7=94 B), delay budget T_e2e, intact tensor delivery probability p_d, and binomial quorum probability P_q; §6 (pp. 6-8, Tables 2-3, Figs. 1-3) evaluates a 256x80x80 tensor under IEEE 802.11 ERP-OFDM parameters (b in {32,8,0.8}, R in {6,12,24} Mbit/s, n=6, q in {3,4,5}), showing at R=12 Mbit/s ~3.7% traffic reduction, ~7.9% transmission-time reduction, ~36.5% frame reduction, ~40x T_tx reduction (4.9 s to 122.8 ms) at 0.8 bits/element, p_d=0.70 vs 0.57 at p_f=0.9995, and P_q=0.93 (q=3) vs 0.74 (q=4).","https://science.lpnu.ua/ictee/paper-review-process"]}}
